title: Add a guide on opensearch
body:
OpenSearch provides search for websites from the url bar, you may have been using it without noticing it, works pretty well.

We should add a guide on opensearch in our community websites to show people what can be done when using instantsearch.js/react-instantsearch for OpenSearch.

If opensearch is a good pattern that would benefit our users, then we should have a guide about it.

Example: Try in your browser: "yarn [TAB] lodash", this is opensearch. https://github.com/yarnpkg/website/blob/master/opensearch.xml

It needs to be linked in the `head` like this:

https://github.com/yarnpkg/website/blob/66acf52e8f096bef1d74dce6895874f64b3f44d4/_layouts/default.html#L22
